Trojanbulls Staffordshire bull terrier licenced breeder and Champion stud dogs
Staffordshire Bull Terrier Puppies for sale

answer_points: Prioritise a responsible, health-tested Staffy breeder over simply finding a blue puppy; blue is a colour, not a health guarantee.
Verify credentials rather than treating a directory listing or rating as an endorsement.
Cites The Kennel Club health standard: testing for hereditary cataracts (HC-HSF4), L-2-HGA, elbow dysplasia and eye conditions; prioritise genetic diversity.

What to ask: see the puppy with its mother where raised; see both parents' health-test certificates; L-2-HGA and HC tests; eye and elbow screening; KC registered names/numbers; COI vs breed average; microchipped and vet checked with records; vaccinations, worming, flea treatment; socialisation; current food; written contract and return-to-breeder policy; lifelong advice.

Red flags: won't show puppy with mother; car-park meet or delivery without showing where raised; many breeds/litters always available; deposit pressure; no health-test results; 'rare blue', 'XL', 'micro' marketing; selling before legally old enough; no microchip or vet documentation.
